group_note: All six were read as structure=plain and all six are plain_mcq on E1, so the grouping holds and no member sits apart. Every one of them is the same demand on the same reading: a stem naming a term, event or effect, with four options that are other named members of the same taught set, so all six carry recall + single_step and the reasons differ only in which association is stored. This uniformity is deliberate — v1's failure was giving equal demands unequal labels — and the one field that does vary is justified item by item: elimination is carried by q083 alone, where a single securely-known fact (a sulphur oxide must be present) strikes two named options, while q079, q080, q081, q082 and q084 offer four same-kind terms from the same chapter, so no shortcut could be demonstrated and the label was withheld rather than asserted. On E5 the common device across the packet is other_one_fact, and its entries always name the member the distractor belongs to; neighbouring_fact is used instead where the distractor comes from a different family altogether (the photosynthetic pigments in q079, the ozone and greenhouse topics in q083), and half_true where one half of a printed pair holds (q083 option 3). One distractor (q081 option 1, Calcium carbonate) could not be tied to a route and was left untagged on purpose.
